PathStatistics.description: Path-level statistics from the Monte Carlo simulation.

avg_default_time.description: Average default time (in years) among defaulted paths.

avg_recovery_rate.description: Average recovery rate (decimal fraction) among defaulted paths.

pik_exercise_rate.description: Fraction of coupon dates where PIK was elected.

description: Merton Monte Carlo price of a PIK or toggle bond with path statistics.

average_pik_fraction.description: Average PIK fraction across all coupon dates and paths.

clean_price_pct.description:
Clean price as percentage of par: `dirty_price_pct` minus the accrued
interest at the valuation date.

dirty_price_pct.description:
Dirty price as percentage of par: the mean simulated present value at
the valuation date, including the full next coupon.

effective_spread_bp.description: Effective spread in basis points implied by MC price vs risk-free.

expected_loss.description:
Expected loss as fraction of PIK-aware risk-free PV.

Defined as `1 - mean_mc_pv / risk_free_pv` where the risk-free PV
accounts for the PIK schedule (accreted notional in the no-default
scenario). For Toggle periods, the risk-free scenario assumes cash
(zero hazard implies no PIK trigger).

expected_shortfall_95.description: Expected shortfall at the 95% confidence level.

num_paths.description: Number of independent estimators used (antithetic pairs count once).

standard_error.description: Standard error of the clean price estimate (percentage of par).

unexpected_loss.description: Unexpected loss (standard deviation of path PVs / notional).
